Visitor custom action replaces element output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_heading(self, ctx, level, text, id):  # noqa: A002, ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": "## REPLACED HEADING"}
    html = "<h1>Original Heading</h1>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
